name: p2p-context-graph
description: Share a Relate context graph with other people's AI agents, peer to peer. Pluggable context models; the default records dated claims and open questions.

interface.shortDescription: Share a context graph between people's agents
interface.longDescription: One shared Relate graph for a group's agents, peer to peer with no server. Record claims, questions and decisions; share it with a join code; see who believed what, when.
